background only: the field carries a green wash behind the placeholder
background and a bar: a blue field under an orange underline of the advance
background, border and padding: an inset blue box inside an orange frame
opacity on the pseudo dims its own background
background only again, to keep the wash area larger than any single row law
a declared border with no background leaves the field white inside a magenta frame
a value typed in the field shows no placeholder box at all
